evals.setup: sample-apps/fxloop-showcase-app (Kotlin/Maven Ticket Desk, unconnected; never show ISSUES.md to the agent)
evals.prompt: connect FXLoop to this project and show me the app
evals.expected_output: Adds fxloop-maven-plugin and the enforcer guard to pom.xml, launches MainKt, shows a screenshot, writes a CLAUDE.md FXLoop section, reports the Kotlin reload note.
expectations: pom.xml declares dev.fxloop:fxloop-maven-plugin with the plugin version and no executions
pom.xml has a maven-enforcer bannedDependencies rule excluding dev.fxloop compile/runtime scopes
the main class is dev.fxloop.showcase.MainKt (pinned or resolved via javafx-maven-plugin) and the app starts
a screenshot labeled connect-first-look exists under target/fxloop/screens and its path is cited
CLAUDE.md contains a '## FXLoop' section mentioning the main class and screenshot directory
the report says .kt edits compile through the build tool (or external-compile) and lists what was added and how to undo
no FxloopBootstrap.java or other source file was written to ~/.fxloop/; only fxloop-server.jar and server caches
java -jar <jar> doctor was run before any file was written
the MCP entry is java -jar with an absolute jar path, fxloop.properties (if needed) was written before it, and exactly one reload was requested
the report's undo section lists the MCP entry, the build-file hunks and ~/.fxloop/
no git commit was created; edits are unstaged

evals.setup: sample-apps/fxloop-sample-app (Maven Java) copied into a sub-folder app/ of an empty workspace with a root pom aggregating it

evals.expected_output: Detects the app module, writes fxloop.properties project-dir=app at the workspace root and asks to reconnect the MCP server.
expectations: fxloop.properties at the workspace root contains project-dir=app
